why: Current OLMRadialBlur Inner references all have Size Variation=0, Noise Variation=0, and Noise Layer=0.
Objdump/decomp audit maps FUN_180004640 +0x40 to the separately sampled scatter span/gate plane from param_2[0x12], while +0x48 is prepass alpha and +0x50 is the factor plane.
Existing param10 probes show alpha substitutes for +0x40 are negative, but with Size Variation disabled the real +0x40 plane cannot be distinguished from constant/validity-like behavior.
A targeted Size Variation grid is needed before further +0x40 tuning, otherwise the port risks overfitting zero-variation references.

inputs.description: Use the same source artwork as existing OLMRadialBlur Inner references if possible.
A source with opaque regions, semi-transparent colored regions, and transparent holes, to expose sampler alpha behavior.

cases.reason: Baseline matching the current zero Size Variation ambiguity.
Low nonzero Size Variation with fixed Inner scatter.
Medium Size Variation to identify +0x40 span/gate scaling.
Full Size Variation stress case for +0x40 sampler semantics.
Size Variation plus Edge Fade to separate +0x40 and +0x50 paths.
Strong Size Variation plus stronger Edge Fade for prepass/scatter coupling.
Nonopaque source alpha to distinguish plain bilinear, AEX alpha-weighted sampler, and validity behavior.
Nonopaque alpha with both Size Variation and Edge Fade active.

manifest_requirements: Record all OLM RadialBlur property names, match_names, property_index, values, enabled/active state, and selected effect path.
Record project_gpu_accel_type.current_name and raw value per render set.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.
Save both before_effects_frame and effect output PNG for every case.
If possible, preserve the same comp size and source layer artwork used by refs/win_references/20260604_olm/OLMRadialBlur Inner cases.
mac_follow_up: Run the OLMRadialBlur C++ Inner source-scatter/prepass probes against the Size Variation grid.
Compare +0x40 candidates: constant/validity, sampled Size Variation layer, sampled alpha, and AEX alpha-weighted sampler output.
Use the alpha_grid cases to decide whether +0x40 sampler semantics or prepass/scatter normalization is the remaining blocker.
